steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest: fill the gaps (3 min)
steps.instructions: Review words from P3 (10): major in = học chuyên ngành · pursue = theo đuổi · internship = đợt thực tập · hands-on = thực hành, làm trực tiếp · deadline = hạn chót · acquire = tiếp thu, đạt được (kỹ năng) · flexible = linh hoạt · passionate about = đam mê · fulfilling = mang lại cảm giác ý nghĩa, thỏa mãn · overwhelmed = quá tải, choáng ngợp. Fill the gaps with the words in the box. Box: acquire · overwhelmed · deadline · pursue · hands-on · flexible · internship · fulfilling

items.label: 1. My dream is to ______ a career in medicine.
2. I have a ______ job: I can choose my own working hours.
3. She felt ______ because she had five exams in one week.
4. During my ______, I worked in a hotel for three months.
5. Cooking classes are very ______: you make the food yourself.
6. The ______ for the essay is next Friday.
7. Helping other people is a very ______ experience.
8. You can ______ a lot of useful skills at a part-time job.

steps.title: Step 2 · Dictation: numbers, dates and spelling (5 min)
steps.instructions: Listen to 8 sentences. Each sentence is read twice. Write the missing information. Numbers as digits. Tip: -teen is stressed at the end (six-TEEN), -ty at the start (SEV-enty).

items.label: 1. The library opens at ______ a.m.
2. There are ______ students in my study group.
3. The dictionary costs £ ______
4. Student number: ______
5. The exam is on the ______ of May.
6. Teacher's surname: ______
7. The group meets on ______.
8. Room ______ is on the second floor.

steps.title: Step 3 · Listening: sports centre form (6 min)
steps.instructions: Before you listen: read the form for 30 seconds and decide the type of word (name / day / time / number / thing). Play the audio ONCE. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. Listen for corrections: the answer is the final information. HILLSIDE SPORTS CENTRE · Adult swimming class.

items.label: 1. Surname: Ms ______
2. Day: ______ evening
3. Class starts at: ______ p.m.
4. Price for students: £ ______
5. Students must bring a ______

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: numbers (30 s)
steps.instructions: Read these aloud clearly: 13 · 30 · 15 · 50 · 17 · 70. Then read this phone number: 0915 447 280.
steps.note: Thầy nghe trọng âm -teen / -ty và cách đọc double four.
